description: This file defines the absl::Span template class for referencing contiguous array data without owning it, along with related factory functions, operators, and utilities. It provides a lightweight, non-owning array view similar to std::span, with additional features and compatibility considerations.

classes.name: absl::Span
classes.description: A template class representing a non-owning view of a contiguous sequence of elements of type T, supporting various constructors, accessors, and subview operations.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data array.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the span (alias for size).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element at index i with bounds checking.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses element at index i with bounds checking and exception on out-of-range.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns reference to the first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns reference to the last element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator just beyond the last element.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns const iterator just beyond the last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: crbegin
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator to the last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator just before the first element.

methods.name: crend
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator just before the first element.

methods.name: remove_prefix
methods.description: Removes the first n elements from the span.

methods.name: remove_suffix
methods.description: Removes the last n elements from the span.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a subspan starting at position 'pos' with length 'len'.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span of the first 'len' elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span of the last 'len' elements.

methods.name: AbslHashValue
methods.description: Hash function support for Span.
